wikipedia-mercy-mercy-me-2026-08-23.normalizedText: Mercy Mercy Me (The Ecology) is a song by American singer-songwriter Marvin Gaye. It was released as the second single from American singer-songwriter Marvin Gaye's 1971 album, What's Going On.

wikipedia-inner-city-blues-2026-08-23.normalizedText: Inner City Blues (Make Me Wanna Holler) was released as the third and final single, and the climactic song from his 1971 landmark album, What's Going On.
